title: 第1614章 第一次尝试杀仙鹤
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【少年郎，你想得到他的东西，不可能。】

林风满脸可惜的看了一眼玉玺。

【多谢诸位前辈。】

【少年郎，这是要去挑战仙鹤了吗？】

【村里有阵法，你可以先去激活阵法。】

林风没想到，村子中央，就在水井旁边，还有2个阵法，是复活阵和传送阵。

绑定之后，下次再来就不用满世界寻找蓬莱岛了。

【诸位前辈，我去试一试。】

【少年郎，祝你好运。】

【仙途坦荡。】

晃悠一圈无果后，林风决定先找仙鹤试一试。

毕竟就算知道的再多，没有实力一切都白搭。

突破9重天必定需要很强很强的实力。

第一步，就要得到仙鹤内丹。

不然的话，在蓬莱岛举步维艰。

当林风走出小河村的时候，仙人依旧在村口等着。

她脸上带着好奇：【你和他们说了什么？】

林风苦笑道：【都是一些没有营养的东西。】

虽说没什么营养，不过也让林风知道蓬莱岛的一切。

他心中的疑惑更盛。

仙人呢？她一直停在这里做什么？

她也没遭到仙鹤攻击。

【仙人，你。。想要我帮你什么来着？】

【我不知道成仙的方法，但是我觉得成仙的方法，一直就藏在那些浮岛上，我又上不去那里。】

她是NPC。

不能像林风一样四处询问别的NPC。

也不能接到任务。

一切都靠自己脑子里储备的知识，主脑赋予她的能力。

林风心中长舒一口气，笑着说道：【仙人，你可能永远也无法成为仙人。】

【为什么？】

【你是什么职业？】

【职业？我没职业。】

林风越发肯定，仙人想成仙比她想出去还难。

以前成仙的人，诸如万兽尊者，他们只是故事背景设定。

现在的天下，真正成仙的，应该一个都没有。

108个位置，全都留给玩家的。

主脑，也就是天道，早就堵死NPC成仙的道路。

【成不了就是成不了，我也不知道。】

仙人想不明白，为什么那么确定成不了仙，又不知道呢？

刚想开口询问。

[Young man, it’s impossible for you to get his things.】

Lin Feng glanced at Yuxi with a look of pity on his face.

[Thank you, seniors.】

[Young man, are you going to challenge the crane?】

[There is a formation in the village, you can activate the formation first.】

Lin Feng did not expect that in the center of the village, right next to the well, there were two formations, the resurrection formation and the teleportation formation.

After binding, you won’t have to look for Penglai Island all over the world next time you come back.

[Seniors, let me give it a try.】

[Young man, I wish you good luck.】

【The road to immortality is open and open.】

After wandering around to no avail, Lin Feng decided to give the crane a try first.

After all, no matter how much you know, without strength, everything is in vain.

Breaking through the 9th level must be very strong.

The first step is to obtain the crane inner elixir.

Otherwise, it will be difficult to move around Penglai Island.

When Lin Feng walked out of Xiaohe Village, the immortal was still waiting at the entrance of the village.

There was curiosity on her face: [What did you say to them?】

Lin Feng smiled bitterly and said: [They are all nutritious things.】

Although it has little nutrition, it still lets Lin Feng know everything about Penglai Island.

The doubts in his heart became more intense.

Where is the immortal?What's she doing here all this time?

She wasn't attacked by cranes either.

[Immortal, you..What do you want me to help you with?】

[I don’t know the way to become an immortal, but I think the way to become an immortal has always been hidden on those floating islands, and I can’t get there.】

She is an NPC.

You can't go around asking other NPCs like Lin Feng.

You can't receive tasks either.

Everything relies on the knowledge stored in her mind and the abilities given to her by the mastermind.

Lin Feng breathed a sigh of relief and said with a smile: [Immortal, you may never become an immortal.】

【Why?】

【What is your occupation?】

【Profession?I don't have a career.】

Lin Feng became more and more certain that it was more difficult for an immortal to become an immortal than for her to get out.

People who became immortals in the past, such as the Lord of Ten Thousand Beasts, were just background settings in the story.

In the world today, there should be no one who has truly become an immortal.

There are 108 positions, all reserved for players.

The mastermind, that is, Tiandao, has long blocked the NPC's path to immortality.

[If it can’t be done, it won’t be done. I don’t know.】

The immortal couldn't understand why he was so sure he couldn't become an immortal and yet he didn't know?

I was about to ask.
